_about: SAN-1321 — expected public.mastra_* schema for the MDE production feature contract, plus the @mastra/core + @mastra/pg pairing that produces it.
_derivation: The expectedTables list is the live schema of production project zkwcbyxiwklihegjhuql (32 tables), verified 2026-09-18. adapterVersion is the @mastra/pg release published the same day as the installed @mastra/core (2026-05-15); a fresh `npm run mastra:init` with @mastra/pg@1.11.0 creates 33 tables that are a strict superset of this list (only mastra_favorites extra). The previous @mastra/pg@1.1.0-alpha.2 pin created only 8 of them.
_why: src/mastra/lib/storage.ts runs PostgresStore with disableInit: true, so nothing self-heals at runtime. A fresh environment provisioned with a mis-paired adapter would silently miss most of this schema. This file is the contract; scripts/check-mastra-schema-contract.mjs reports drift between it and the installed packages.
_maintenance: When @mastra/core / @mastra/pg are upgraded, run `npm run mastra:init` against a scratch Postgres, diff the resulting public.mastra_* set against expectedTables, then update adapterVersion/coreVersion/expectedTables together in one commit.
